snippet.title: Love Craft - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on Steam! ▶ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3691640/Love_Craft/

Join the Crafting Club, where the glue is strong and the feelings stronger!
Craft chaos, flirt fearlessly, and make some very bad romantic decisions!
Find your project partner in this elimination-based Dating Sim!

Music: Super Friendly by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
